title: Autonomous AI & Voice Agents Engineering Fellowship
content: The Autonomous AI & Voice Agents Engineering Fellowship at Empowers Academy is a 16-week live mentor-led cohort designed for software engineers and final-year CS/IT learners. Curriculum covers real-time WebRTC and SIP telephony pipelines, STT/LLM/TTS orchestration, hybrid RAG architectures, multi-agent tool calling, guardrails, and Kubernetes deployment. Includes 3 production capstone projects and weekly 1-on-1 code reviews. Tuition fee is INR 65,000 (or USD 800) with zero-cost EMI starting at INR 5,417/month for 12 months. Next cohort starts on the 1st Monday of next month.

title: Cloud Engineering, Kubernetes & DevOps Career Accelerator
content: The Cloud & DevOps Career Accelerator is a 14-week hands-on bootcamp covering Linux administration, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform Infrastructure as Code, GitHub Actions CI/CD, AWS & Microsoft Azure production architecture, and observability with Prometheus and Grafana. Tuition is INR 48,000 (or USD 600) with zero-cost EMI from INR 4,000/month over 12 months. Includes real cloud sandbox credits and mock SRE/DevOps system design interviews.

title: Full-Stack Generative AI & Agentic Systems Cohort
content: The Full-Stack GenAI Cohort is a 12-week program ideal for freshers, college students, and career switchers. Covers Python backend engineering with FastAPI, prompt engineering, RAG over enterprise documents, vector databases, evaluation harnesses, and deploying full-stack AI SaaS apps. Tuition is INR 39,000 (or USD 490) with zero-cost EMI from INR 3,250/month. Prerequisite is basic familiarity with any programming language.

title: Career Services, Placement Assistance & Outcomes
content: Empowers Academy provides dedicated Career Acceleration support for 6 months post-graduation: ATS resume optimization, GitHub portfolio audits, 5 live technical mock interviews with industry hiring managers, and direct hiring referrals to 120+ partner startups and enterprise AI teams across India and the UAE. Average reported salary hike for placed working professionals is 45% to 80%. Note: we offer structured placement assistance and guaranteed interview loops rather than a fake 100% job guarantee.

title: Fees, No-Cost EMI, Scholarships & Refund Policy
content: All Empowers Academy programs support 6-month and 12-month no-cost EMI via major Indian cards and NBFC education partners, plus a 10% upfront pay-in-full discount. Merit and early-bird scholarships up to 20% are awarded after a free 15-minute Career Counseling & Readiness Assessment call. Every enrollment includes a transparent 7-day no-questions-asked 100% refund window after cohort kickoff.

title: Live Class Timings, Recordings, Mentorship & Certification
content: Classes are built for working professionals and college students: live interactive sessions run Saturday and Sunday (10:00 AM to 1:00 PM IST) plus two optional weekday evening doubt-clearing office hours (8:00 PM IST). Learners receive lifetime LMS access to HD recordings, GitHub starter repos, Slack/Discord mentor channels, and an industry-verified Empowers Academy & Fortivex AI completion certificate upon shipping their capstone.
